summary: Mannatech filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq deficiency notice (received April 20, 2026) for failing the $2,500,000 minimum stockholders' equity rule, with reported equity of $(5,223,000) at December 31, 2025 and $(4,970,000) at June 30, 2026. The company disclosed an intercompany share purchase agreement giving it 100% direct ownership of Mannatech Swiss Holdings GmbH, previously held indirectly through Mannatech (Gibraltar) Holdings Limited, which qualifies for a reduced 5% Swiss withholding rate. Mannatech asserts pro forma compliance, subject to auditor review and Nasdaq concurrence.
